date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification:
R5-EA-002-D1: Permission/availability endpoint only: tourists declined to use it that day, so no first visitor passage is established. Myanmar returnees were excepted. Later March 28 narrative overlaps the same incident and is not treated as a new closure; Bridge II cargo and inland roads are separate.

Additional within-day distinction: Eleven Media reports movement toward Thailand restored around 10:30 on March 25 after a morning blockage. That direction-specific account does not establish an earlier end of the restriction on Thai and foreign visitors entering Myanmar, for which The Nation reports restored permission on March 26 and no actual visitor crossings that day. The March 28 report recounts fighting beginning March 25, not a separately established new closure.
